question: the round brief and CLAUDE.md both call 0.7364 / 0.4650 / 0.3240 the 'always-7B GREEDY' cells and charge them 1.0 FLOP-eq. Are they greedy?
how_this_was_found: vote@8 minus greedy came out EXACTLY 0.0000 with a zero-width bootstrap CI on SLAKE_open (645/645 items identical), which is impossible for two independently generated arms.

MACRO8_consequence.how: five of the eight cells are untouched (their published value IS a real greedy decode); the three open cells move by the measured per-cell difference. The macro is the equal-weight mean over eight cells, so the shift is (sum of the three per-cell differences) / 8, bootstrapped by resampling items inside each of the three moving cells.
MACRO8_consequence.and_it_is_cheaper: the corrected baseline is a REAL greedy decode on all eight cells, so it costs 1.0 FLOP-eq, against 1.513738 for the published one.
MACRO8_consequence.read_as_an_intervention: stated the other way round: DELETING self-consistency from the three open cells of the published baseline is the cheapest intervention this round found -- it moves the macro UP and cuts baseline compute by a third.

CODE_CITATIONS_the_repo_already_says_so_: src/cascade_methods/gen_slake_open_bestofN.py:138  greedy_ok = int(aj[i].get(modal_norm, 0)) -- the field is WRITTEN as the modal-of-8 label
src/cascade_methods/verifier_n_scaling.py:173  '# NB: this is the MODAL-of-8 answer, i.e. SC@8'
CONSEQUENCE_accuracy: on the three open cells the 'always-7B greedy' baseline IS self-consistency@8. Attack 2 asks whether self-consistency beats always-7B greedy; on 3 of the 8 cells the incumbent baseline was already self-consistency@8, so that comparison was self-referential until this round supplied a real greedy control.

CONSEQUENCE_cost.arithmetic: five cells at 1.0 plus three cells at the measured 2.369969 = 1.513738
CONSEQUENCE_cost.read: the baseline every arm in this round is measured against is not a 1.0 FLOP-eq baseline. It is a 1.51 FLOP-eq baseline under the project's own measured generation cost, because three of its eight cells already pay for eight samples.

WHAT_IS_NOT_CLAIMED: this does NOT say any published DELTA is wrong. Every arm in the open-cell chain (verifier, head, oracle) was compared against the same greedy_ok field, so the deltas are internally consistent. What is wrong is the LABEL on the baseline and the 1.0 charged for it.
